declarations.name: Theorem J1. Exact Hermite coefficient charts
declarations.scope: For a>=2,n>2a,s=n-a-1, every polynomial of passport(2^n),(2^a1^(2n-2a)),T^s has an exact Hermite power chart f=(vQ+P_+^2 P_-^2 R)^2, degP_+=j,degP_-=a-j,degR=n-2a. Q is the unique CRT interpolant +/-1 modulo the two squares. A=H'/(nP) and C(Y)=Norm_(C[z]/A)(Y-H^2) give all necessary and sufficient discriminant/nonzero/collision exclusions. Balanced phase bins require the explicit swap involution.

declarations.name: Theorem J2. Nonemptiness, components, and rationality
declarations.scope: For every n>2a>=4 and j=0..floor(a/2), the exact chart open is nonempty and irreducible. A Rolle/interpolation perturbation proves uniform nonemptiness, independently of the imported BG component theorem. Phase counts separate the resulting complete list of components. Centering and scaling, followed by the balanced-bin swap if needed, have diagonal rational invariant fields, proving each affine-quotient component rational overQ and of complex dimension n-a-1.

declarations.name: Theorem J3. Actual groups, every block, and exact sizes
declarations.scope: Every such phase component has the identical actual group S_n wr C2, order2(n!)^2, every block divisor{1,2,2n} and deck1. Canonical transposition blocks and the return budget exclude all larger dihedral quotients in n>2a. Exact full literal size is L*2^s*(2-indicator(2j=a))*C_n(j,a-j;s), L=(s+2)(s+1), with B4's elementary factorial count; absolute size divides by2n. The proof uses lower critical-value square-root choices and sign quotient, not an extrapolated finite census.

declarations.name: Proposition J4. Two explicit rational surfaces in degree ten
declarations.scope: For n5,a2 the two components have explicit Hermite surfaces H0=-v+[z(z-1)]^2(z+t) and H1=v(1-6z^2+4z^3)+[z(z-1)]^2(z+t), with exact norm exclusions. Pair reversal sends(t,v) to(-1-t,-v) or(-1-t,v), giving rational quotient coordinates((2t+1)/v,v^2) and((2t+1)^2,v). Literal sizes2400/6000, absolute240/600, fixed-type critical-value degrees20/50. Their intrinsic branch classes already differ; this is not a new genuine lifting split.
